channel.title: Steam Deals Tracker
channel.description: Temporarily free and newly added Steam deals.

item.title: 99Day Survival Guide
item.description: A fast-paced co-op zombie survival action game where players fight through hordes of enemies, unlock random power-ups, build different synergies, and escape together as a team.

item.title: Agromatic
item.description: A farming and automation game where your automation is people. Hire workers, pay their salaries, build their houses, and lay out your farms and factories like a town. Produce and sell valuable goods to keep your business profitable. This isn't colony survival, it's running a company.

item.title: Arcade Paradise
item.description: Turn a rundown laundromat into a radical ’90s arcade. Manage your business, expand your neon empire, and balance dirty laundry with over 35 playable arcade games. Build the ultimate arcade! From the team behind Vampire Crawlers.

item.title: Combustor
item.description: Gas reaction simulator. Build the ultimate jet engine, solve puzzles, or just make everything explode!

item.title: FireAlpaca SE
item.description: FireAlpaca SE is painting software for Windows/Mac that has evolved as a higher brand of the regular version of FireAlpaca. We provide a professional creative environment where your creativity can be visualized immediately.

item.title: Made in Abyss: Binary Star Falling into Darkness
item.description: Experience the awesome power of the Curse of the Abyss, as well as the astonishing, legendary entities known as primeval creatures. Prepare to glimpse the world of Riko and her friends.

item.title: MARVEL Cosmic Invasion - Cyclops & The Thing
item.description: Two new Super Heroes join the fight against Annihilus! Play as The Thing and Cyclops in this first downloadable content update for MARVEL Cosmic Invasion.

item.title: Powder Park: Ski Resort Builder
item.description: Shape the mountain. Build the lifts and jumps. Then ride it yourself, solo or with friends. A cozy ski resort builder from one of the original creators of Ski Resort Tycoon.

item.title: System Arrival
item.description: Top-down co-op survival action RPG for 1–4 players in a world the System turned into a game. Earn levels, quests and psychic powers, scavenge the ruins, fight zombies and build an underground bunker for survivors — then find out what the System really wants.

item.title: Taimanin Asagi 2
item.description: Taimanin Asagi, the legendary anti-demon ninja, returns in the second installment of this classic visual novel series! Asagi and Sakura head to Tokyo Kingdom, a lawless district overrun with demons and criminals, to determine the whereabouts of their fellow Taimanin who have gone missing in action.

item.title: Towers of Babble
item.description: Word Game Tower Defense. Spell AXE to harvest wood. Spell FORT to make an armored tower. Every word you spell becomes a tower with unique stats and powers. Every word is also a unique level with procedural challenges. 121,683 levels. Together we must clear them all to reach paradise.

item.title: DAWN AEROWAR
item.description: A two-hour animated film. Follow Zodiac 1, an ace pilot out for revenge against the Empire, across 12 episodes of 3D dogfights and hand-drawn 2D animation, with a full voice cast and an original orchestral score. Nearly five years of work by a handful of independent artists.

item.title: Diplomacy is Not an Option: Fog of War
item.description: Fog of War is a DLC for the Diplomacy is Not an Option. In the new story campaign, you’ll build cities, conquer strongholds, and defend against waves of enemy hordes in epic battles. Continue the story of the Ironbrow dynasty and help the young Prince save the long-suffering Samreignia.

item.title: FailRooms
item.description: Experience liminal horror like never before. Inspired by the Backrooms, FailRooms traps you in an endless world of absurd architecture, broken spaces, and things that should never have been built. Laugh while you can. Can you escape a place that was never designed to make sense?

item.title: Fretless - The Wrath of Riffson
item.description: In this turn-based RPG, wield powerful legendary instruments, gather mighty riff attacks and save the land from Rick Riffson's devilish goons and musical hybrid monsters!

item.title: Golf Course Architect Tycoon
item.description: Build a golf course on raw land, then watch a full field of golfers play it - or play it yourself! See where they struggle, reshape the hole and watch again, all while you run the club growing around it. No grid: sculpt the terrain and paint every surface by hand.

item.title: GroundInFlames
item.description: GroundInFlames is real-time tactics about modern combined-arms warfare. Trenches, suppression and squad morale, FPV drones and electronic warfare, honest armor penetration and vehicle modules. Manpower is scarce, supply runs out, and the enemy only knows what it has seen.

item.title: Hillthorn
item.description: A disappearance in a secluded community. A mountain hiding its secrets. A detective running out of time. Welcome to Hillthorn, a dark investigation game that invites you to uncover the mystery without a single word spoken, using your skills of logic and intuition through cards.

item.title: MARVEL Cosmic Invasion - The Siege of Castle Doom
item.description: The Fantastic Four's most powerful member and their greatest adversary are here! Play as The Invisible Woman and Doctor Doom or face the perils of Castle Doomstadt in a brand new game mode, now in our second DLC for MARVEL Cosmic Invasion!

item.title: Never Sort By Color
item.description: Somewhere under that mountain of bricks is your floor. Sort the impossible Pile with a magnet glove, sieves, and part-seeking vision. Fill labeled drawers, pull parts, watch MOC builds snap together brick by brick. Cozy, satisfying, and governed by one rule: never sort by color.

item.title: Nocturnal 2
item.description: Ignite your sword and explore the dark depths and towering heights of a forgotten island that consumed itself long ago.

item.title: Shelves and Sorcery - Too Many Potions!
item.description: You said there were too many potions. We took that as a challenge! Help an eccentric alchemist organize over 4,000 potions in The Overflowing Flask, a peculiar shop at the edge of the world. With every shelf open to any potion, organize them however you like!

item.title: Slitterhead
item.description: "I must eliminate them...ALL..." The bodiless "Hyoki" hunts down the brain-devouring "Slitterheads", lurking in the alleys of a neon-lit city

item.title: Stormforge
item.description: Brave magical storms where tornadoes hunt you in this open-world survival crafting game for 1 to 8 players. Outrun the tornadoes or ride their winds, sail to new islands, defeat bosses to unlock classes, and build a home that can weather the next chaos storm.

item.title: Vampire: The Masquerade - Oaths & Ashes
item.description: Two vampires — an ambitious Kindred and a wretched Thinblood. Their fates clash in this Visual Novel set in the World of Darkness, where your arsenal extends beyond just words — from political machinations to forbidden Alchemy. Claw your way to power and leave your bitemarks on Berlin's underworld.

item.title: We Steal From Old People: The Game
item.description: Beat swarms of old people and take their bricks in this action roguelike. Rip them from their disgusting old hands. You need bricks. You need all the bricks for yourself because you’re a slimy little brick weasel. You are like a brick vampire and bricks are the blood you need!

item.title: Wizardry: The Five Ordeals
item.description: Welcome to the world of dungeon crawling! The classic dungeon crawler released back in 2006, returns to Steam with improved UI and more.

item.title: Zero Escape: The Nonary Games
item.description: Kidnapped and taken to an unfamiliar location, nine people find themselves forced to participate in a diabolical Nonary Game by an enigmatic mastermind called Zero. Why were they there? Why were they chosen to put their lives on the line? And more importantly, who can be trusted?

item.title: Annihilated
item.description: A story-driven roguelite RPG about a journey through the depths with a broken hero — and what they have to answer for. The hero's party has been annihilated: you carry one of them out of a cursed dungeon, learn what broke them, and settle it together. Four routes, four heroes, four reckonings.

item.title: Ashes of the Singularity II
item.description: In this massive RTS game, command vast armies fighting for control of entire worlds. Control the forces of Earth, the mechanical AI Substrate, or the enigmatic Post-Human Coalition as you battle across the solar system in single player, cooperative multiplayer, or competitive multiplayer.

item.title: Booster Pack Heroes
item.description: Rip open booster packs and pull your next foil hero in Booster Pack Heroes - an incremental game where every pack could contain your next powerhouse. Defend the tower from an endless onslaught of monsters and fight your way through the realms.

item.title: Clustertruck
item.description: Clustertruck is a chaotic physics based truckformer. Jump your way through insane levels in a game of "the floor is lava" on top of speeding trucks driven by terrible drivers.

item.title: FEROCIOUS
item.description: Immerse yourself in a survival FPS adventure. Stranded on a dangerous island, face mercenaries, dinosaurs, and a vibrant yet hostile ecosystem. Explore breathtaking environments and survive the onslaught of intense, fast-paced encounters.

item.title: Icy Tower
item.description: The legendary jumping game is back! Join Harold the Homeboy and friends as they jump up the Icy Tower. Make combo jumps to build up massive scores. How high can you get?

item.title: Warhammer Survivors
item.description: Warhammer Survivors is the official grim and dark bullet-heaven game from the developers of Warhammer 40,000 Boltgun. Play as over 40 iconic champions from the Warhammer 40,000 and Warhammer Age of Sigmar universes and obliterate those who champion death and destruction.

item.title: Hunting Simulator 3 - Classic American Hunter Pack
item.description: This open-world game lets you experience the thrill of the hunt, with your faithful dog by your side! Choose your equipment from official brands, and explore the wilderness in search of your next game.
